project.name: fayda-mock-esignet-parent
project.description: Aggregator for the Fayda / VeriFayda 2.0 eSignet mock ecosystem: a mock eSignet OIDC server (mock_server) and a sample relying-party app that authenticates against it (sample_rp). Each module keeps its own independent Spring Boot parent/version - this POM only wires them together as a reactor, it does not unify their dependency management.
